{{Top}} {{Character |type=New Republic |image=[[File:Peekpa.png]] |name=Peekpa |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Ewok]]''[[Last Shot]]'' |gender=[[Gender|Female]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Gray]]{{StoryCite|story=Peekpa's Tale|book=Return of the Jedi – Ewoks 1}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=A [[Peekpa's sister|sister]] |children=new |affiliation=*[[Bright Tree tribe]] *[[New Republic]] **[[Digital Warfare Department]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Anyway, Peekpa is tired of us nakeds leaving our big-deal weapons scattered all over the galaxy for people to use willy-nilly.|Kaasha Bateen translates Peekpa's thoughts during the crew's search for the [[Phylanx Redux Transmitter]]|}} '''Peekpa''' was an [[Ewok]] [[Gender|female]] [[Slicer|hacker]] for the [[New Republic]], tech genius, and a superfan of the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] after he saved the life of her [[Peekpa's sister|sister]] during the [[Battle of Endor]]. She frequently operated a [[datapad]]. In [[7 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Peekpa worked for the [[Digital Warfare Department]] and was in a crew with Chewbacca, [[Han Solo]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], [[Kaasha Bateen]], and [[Taka Jamoreesa]] and embarked on a [[Search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter|mission]] to track down [[Fyzen Gor]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|What?''"
"''«Freebee toosasno! Freebee toosasno!»''"
"''One of us is going to have to learn to speak the other’s language, Peekpa, because—|Han Solo and Peekpa|}} [[File:PeekpaTrapsHoyel-PeekpasTale.png|thumb|left|186px|Peepka stealing an Imperial 74-Z speeder]] During [[4 ABY]], Peekpa took advantage of the increased [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] presence on [[Endor]] to steal their advanced technologies to fuel her special projects. Stealing the head of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport]], parts from a crashed [[74-Z speeder bike]] and several other miscellaneous pieces of scrap, she was able to construct her very own [[Ugly|hotchpotch spaceship]]. With the ship complete, Peekpa gathered the members of [[Bright Tree tribe|her tribe]] to bear witness as she activated the [[engine]]s for the first time. She then departed Endor to travel the Galaxy and satisfy her endless curiosity. By [[7 ABY]], Peekpa's genius had been recognized by the [[New Republic]], earning her a rare status among her people by becoming a member of the New Republic's [[Digital Warfare Department]] on [[Chandrila]]. There she was able to work under the chief of cyberwarfare himself, [[Conder Kyl]], learning even more about technology, notably how to [[Slicer|slice into computers]]. When New Republic heroes, Lando Calrissian and Han Solo, met with Conder to find a slicer to help them retrieve the [[Phylanx Redux Transmitter]], the chief of cyberwarfare recommended Peepka for the mission. Peekpa was initially stubborn to join Han and Lando's mission, however, the Ewok was convinced to join under the condition that the legendary Chewbacca came with them. Peekpa traveled with Han and Lando's motley crew aboard a modified [[ZV-9 freighter]] known as the [[Vermillion (ZV-9 freighter)|''Vermillion'']] to [[Substation Grimdock]] in the [[Expansion Region]]. There, Peekpa used her credentials to pose as an official from the [[Department of Prisons]] on Chandrila; this allowed the team to infiltrate the [[Grimdock Archive]] where Peekpa could search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. Yet despite Peekpa's talent as a slicer, her search through the archives alerted members of the private security force, [[Sef Con]], to the presence of infiltrators. Thus, a firefight broke out and the team was ambushed by attack creatures owned by Sef Con known as [[forosnag]]s. Before the team was overrun, Peekpa sliced the controls of several automated floor panels, prompting them to open up and drop the forosnags into [[Subsector Twelve|Grimdock's twelfth subsector]]. After dealing with more Sef Con security troopers, and a pack of [[bastak]]s, Peekpa and the rest of the team successfully escape Grimdock aboard the ''Vermillion''. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' mistakenly uses an image of [[Chubbray]] to depict Peekpa. ==Appearances== *{{StoryCite|story=Peekpa's Tale|book=Return of the Jedi – Ewoks 1}} *{{StoryCite|story=Wolf Trap|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} *[[Return of the Jedi – Ewoks 1|''Return of the Jedi – Ewoks'' 1]] *''[[Last Shot]]'' {{Ab|Last Shot (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]'' {{Mo}} *[[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]] ==Sources== *''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Peekpa |fr=Peekpa |ka=პიკპა }} [[Category:Bright Tree tribe]] [[Category:Ewoks]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Slicers]]
